1
EXTRAORDINARY REGISTERED NO. S-2771
BALOCHISTAN PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY
SECRETARIAT.
THE BALOCHISTAN CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL
MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
ACT, 1975.
th
(Amended upto 9 October, 2014).
An Act to provide for the Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of the
Chief Minister and the Provincial Ministers of the Government of
Balochistan.
The bill was passed by the Balochistan Provincial Assembly on 07-
04-1975 and after having received the assent of the Governor of
Balochistan, published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly, in the
rd
Balochistan Gazette (Extra-ordinary) dated 23 April, 1975.
